title: Better Telegram Search v0.2.0
notes:
Local CPU search for Telegram Desktop JSON archives: messages, photos, and text inside images.

### What's new

- Switch the entire interface between Russian and English with the RU / EN slider at the top. Your choice is saved in this browser.
- Search, filters, settings, model preparation, import previews, conflict resolution, warnings, and result dates follow the selected language. Conversation content, names, queries, and entered paths keep their original text.
- English quickstart and standalone build instructions are available alongside Russian documentation. Both build guides are included in the packages.

### Downloads

| Platform | Architecture | Minimum OS | Archive |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Windows | x64 | Windows 10 1903+ | better-telegram-search-0.2.0-win32-x86_64.zip |
| Linux | x64 | Ubuntu 22.04+ / glibc 2.35+ | better-telegram-search-0.2.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz |
| Linux | ARM64 | Ubuntu 22.04+ / glibc 2.35+ | better-telegram-search-0.2.0-linux-arm64.tar.gz |
| macOS | Intel | macOS 15 | better-telegram-search-0.2.0-darwin-x86_64.zip |
| macOS | Apple Silicon | macOS 15 | better-telegram-search-0.2.0-darwin-arm64.zip |

Extract the entire archive. Launch BetterTelegramSearch/telegram-search.exe on Windows, BetterTelegramSearch/telegram-search on Linux, or Better Telegram Search.app on macOS. Your browser opens at http://127.0.0.1:8765. Select EN with the language slider.

Click **Import archive**, enter the path to result.json, then **Check export** and **Apply changes**. Enter a query and click **Search**. Keyword search works immediately. Prepare the models in **Settings and diagnostics** to use semantic search, photo search, or OCR. For semantic search, select **Meaning** or **Keywords and meaning**, then click **Search**. Select any combination of Text, Images, and OCR under **Search in**.

Python, uv, and Node.js are not required to run a packaged build. E5 and CLIP download separately; OCR rus/eng dictionaries are included. Processing stays local on CPU; semantic and photo search use ONNX Runtime. Keep your export folder for its original photos. Close the old app before updating; application data stays in a separate folder.
